hazards.hazardous_event: Loss of command delivery to safety-critical zone (e.g. braking actuator)
hazards.safe_state: Watchdog keeper and deadline monitor jointly detect a non-responsive zone and signal a fault; see ASIL Determination Note below regarding decomposition to the currently-targeted ASIL-B mechanisms.
hazards.safety_goal: SG-001: Commands to safety-critical zones shall be delivered within the watchdog period or a fault shall be signalled.

hazards.hazardous_event: Spurious command sent to the wrong zone controller
hazards.safe_state: rcp_controller_send() rejects the command with RCP_ERR_ZONE_MISMATCH before invoking any handler
hazards.safety_goal: SG-002: Commands shall only be processed by the zone they are addressed to; misrouted commands shall be rejected.

hazards.hazardous_event: Zone controller watchdog not kicked, leading to unintended reset
hazards.safe_state: Priority-queue and rate-limit Critical-priority bypass guarantee RCP_CMD_WATCHDOG is always deliverable at the configured priority
hazards.safety_goal: SG-003: The watchdog kick command shall always be deliverable at the configured priority.

hazards.hazardous_event: Replay of stale commands from a previous drive cycle
hazards.safe_state: 32-entry sliding-window bitmap detects and rejects replayed or out-of-window sequence numbers
hazards.safety_goal: SG-004: Replayed or duplicated commands from prior sessions shall be detected and rejected.

hazards.hazardous_event: Zone controller falsely reported as alive when unresponsive
hazards.safe_state: Deadline monitor transitions a zone to Faulted after missing its configured Status deadline
hazards.safety_goal: SG-007: A zone controller that stops publishing Status shall be detected as dead within the configured deadline.

hazards.hazardous_event: Priority inversion — low-priority burst starves safety-critical watchdog kicks
hazards.safe_state: Priority queue always dispatches RCP_PRIORITY_CRITICAL entries ahead of High/Normal
hazards.safety_goal: SG-001, SG-005: Commands to safety-critical zones delivered within the watchdog period; Critical commands never delayed by lower-priority ones.

hazards.hazardous_event: Rate limiter blocks watchdog kick during high command burst
hazards.safe_state: Rate limiter exempts RCP_PRIORITY_CRITICAL commands from the token bucket
hazards.safety_goal: SG-003, SG-005: Watchdog kick always deliverable; Critical commands never delayed.

hazards.hazardous_event: Unauthorized command injection via unsecured transport
hazards.safe_state: Mutual TLS authentication required before any command is accepted from a transport peer
hazards.safety_goal: SG-006: Transport authentication (mTLS or equivalent) shall be enforced on all external zone controller connections.

hazards.hazardous_event: Power state management failure — zone not properly woken from sleep
hazards.safe_state: Zone only declared operational after a successful RCP_CMD_WAKE response gate
hazards.safety_goal: SG-001, SG-008: Commands delivered within watchdog period; zone declared operational only after successful Wake response.

hazards.hazardous_event: Fault injection state persists across vehicle power cycles
hazards.safe_state: Fault injection rules held only in-process memory of the injecting process; never persisted to disk
hazards.safety_goal: SG-009: Fault injection rules shall not persist beyond the lifetime of the injecting process.

note: ASIL values are computed via `cfusa hara asil` (ISO 26262-3:2018 Table 4) from each hazard's S/E/C classification. See HARA.md's 'ASIL Determination Note' for a discovered discrepancy against cpp-RCP's own hand-authored HARA table, which used the same S/E/C classifications but recorded lower ASIL-B/A letters for several hazards, and HARA.md's 'Safety Goals' table for the full SG-001..SG-010 list (kept in Markdown, not duplicated here, since c-FuSa's HARA002/HARA003 rules scan every top-level '"id"' occurrence in this file as if it were a hazard entry).
